name: Telecom tariffs (India)
description: Prepaid tariffs before and after the July 2024 increases, with postpaid terms as a distractor.
data_note: Documents written by a teammate (Anuvesha) in the style of the cited sources and kept as given (bold markers removed); figures were not re-checked against the live sources. Questions with origin 'hand' were written by her; 'synthetic' ones by RAGSeal's builder from exact quotes.
sources: telecom_tariffs_pre_july2024.md | Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) Tariff Filings Archive | Dated: 01-Jan-2024

distractor_postpaid_plans.md | Enterprise Postpaid Service Agreement Terms | Dated: 01-Feb-2024
risk_rules: Never quote a pre-July-2024 prepaid price as current.
